reviews.text:
I ended my subscription a few days ahead of time and it just now tells me the day of it hadn’t ended

I canceled my subscription a few days before the renewal date, but when the expected cancellation date arrived, I was still being shown as subscribed. I only found out on the day it was supposed to end that the cancellation apparently hadn’t gone through.

The cancellation process should clearly confirm whether a subscription has actually been canceled and show the exact date it will end. This was confusing and frustrating because I believed I had already canceled it ahead of time.

Plus- i loaded my song and lyrics then a few days later, (which was too long to wait) it decides to actually let me press play and listen to it once it asked me to renew subscription or pay🫩 . Why is there a trial run if it doesn’t work properly!! app issues.

reviews.text: It made one song that matched the description I gave it all except it used female vocals when I directed it to use male vocals. It also only used about 1/2 of my lyrics so it cut the song off in the middle. Then there is no option to have the song remade if it’s not what you wanted. So you have to start all the way over from scratch. So I put all of the same inputs and lyrics in again but this time when I ask for 90’s alt rock style with a mellow melancholic tone, it produced a song that was rap in an Eminem style. It was no where near what I wanted. So then I gave up on the app. It’s got potential but it’s not there yet. Also it wants to charge me $$ for a digital PDF to prove I made the song. Then if you want a video made it wants another $$. These charges are additional to the monthly sub charge $. So unless an app developer gets back with me I am headed to social media to go ahead and put the word out about what a scam this app is with all the pay walls, not even a cheap pay wall either. It’s double digits for anything. Now I would love to see this app be successful and live up to its potential because it has potential but it needs some tweaking. Definitely needs to use all the lyrics, and at the minimum get the genre of music and make or female vocals right. Like the app sits I do not recommend it. With some updates and lower fees I would love to see more of it.

In every song my voice sounded like a distorted robot. I was dissatisfied because you have to pay to record again to fix it. Why would I pay again? The Apple Store refused to refund and I don’t even have any history asking for refunds so that was very telling. Be careful with this app. The pay structure is deceptive and it will generate something poor quality you are stuck with, which means you continue to pay again with hopes it ever gives you a quality result.

reviews.title: Not Worth Paying For Robotic Covers
reviews.text:
I was really disappointed with this app. The feature that lets you create a sample of your own voice is locked behind a paywall, which already felt frustrating. On top of that, before you can even use it, they make you read a long scripted paragraph about how great the app is, so you end up recording yourself saying how “amazing” it is. That felt forced and gimmicky.

The actual song cover results were not good either. No matter what song I tried, and even when the key matched my natural tone, the output sounded robotic and fake. It did not sound like me, and it definitely did not sound like a real singer. The voice sounded synthetic, lacked emotion, warmth, and any kind of natural flow.

Overall, it feels overhyped and overpriced for the quality you get. I would not recommend paying for this unless the voice technology improves a lot.

All images appear to be female even when the song is male. 

Additionally in settings when you select a male voice it presents a female vocal track. Also when you record a male voice for 5 minutes so it will produce a cover in your own voice, it also came out as a female range, vocal!  I mean, I can sing almost 6 octaves, but even so!!  It definitely wasnt me!!

Update January 2026 - the latest glitch is that you can play songs from the library index, but if you open the file it won’t play.   Also the “help” email address is not real. So no help available in app or from the “support email”. Useless.
